question: When did Coinbase launch the Base network

snippets.text: Today, we’re excited to announce the testnet launch of Base, an [Ethereum](https://www.coinbase.com/en-in/price/ethereum?country=US&currency=USD&mobile=false&japan_bespoke_content=false&logged_in=false&null=) Layer 2 (L2) network offering a secure, low-cost, developer-friendly way for anyone, anywhere, to build decentralized apps or “dapps” onchain.
**The cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase has announced the deployment of Base, an Ethereum layer two (L2) scaling network, after developers launched the Base testnet on Thursday.

[Coinbase](https://techcrunch.com/2023/02/21/coinbase-shares-rise-q4-2022/) , the second largest crypto exchange by trading volume, has launched [Base](http://base.org) , an Ethereum-focused layer-2 (L2) blockchain, Jesse Pollak, lead for Base and head of protocols at Coinbase, told TechCrunch.

* [Introduced](https://www.coinbase.com/blog/introducing-base) by Coinbase in February 2023, Base is an Ethereum layer-2 blockchain built in collaboration with blockchain developer Optimism, which aims to provide a safe and low-cost platform for blockchain application developers.
